content:
Hi everyone! We’re excited to share Proof-Refactor — a process-guided agentic framework for refactoring generated Lean 4 proofs into more modular, readable, and reusable artifacts.

The motivation is simple: AI-generated proofs can compile, but they often do not look like proofs one would want to maintain in a library. Our focus is structural refactoring rather than golfing. Motivated by how humans refactor proofs, Proof-Refactor decomposes the workflow into four phases — Extract, Design, Prove, and Repair — using a tactic to turn local proof fragments into standalone lemmas.

We believe this demonstrates a practical path toward making formalization more maintainable after generation: AI systems should not only produce compiling proofs, but also help turn them into reusable formalization infrastructure.

Project website:
https://pelicanhere.github.io/proof-refactor-site/

GitHub repo:
https://github.com/pelicanhere/proof-refactor

Paper:
https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03743

Feedback and discussions are very welcome!
